item.title: Protests erupt in West Bank as Israel approves death penalty for Palestinians
item.summary: Hundreds of protesters took to the streets across the embattled Palestinian territories on Tuesday, a day after Israel's parliament passed a measure establishing the death penalty by hanging for Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis.
